about: GPS ground movement at the 2026-07-28 Kumamoto earthquake: the input to pipeline/slip.py. Steps in cm: east, north, up.
source: research/validation-sources.md, section 2b (NGL GNSS stations, checked by the parent). The steps are NOT published values: they are the median of 7 daily positions before 2026-07-28 against the median of the 7 after (G071 has only 5 after), from Nevada Geodetic Laboratory (NGL) daily positions. The post-event week includes some early afterslip. NGL station ID = GEONET station (J/G + last three digits of the GEONET code); that mapping is inferred from the two agreeing, not looked up.
gsi_note: gsi_cm is the value published by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI), as quoted in the HERP PDF in the same section: a text string kept as found (size and direction, plus the vertical where given). NGL and GSI agree to within about 1-2 cm.

stations.name: 城南 Jōnan
stations.note: Sits about 2.8 km beyond the north-east end of the drawn line, where the break continued but was located only by town name. Left out of the fit; its miss is reported.

not_used: Just outside the frame, so not used: G075 (球磨) +1.9 E / -11.9 N (GSI 11.3 cm); G265 (installed 2026-07-08) +1.7 / -8.8; J700 -0.4 / +3.3; J466 -4.1 / -1.2. G072 and G169 ended in 2008 and 2018.
